name: CSiS.net.au
summary: Sutherland Shire computer shop "Computing Success" with a dialup + email + Net-café ISP arm (csis.net.au); retail ISP gone by ~2001, domain later reused.

events.details: "Computing Success Online" (Sutherland Shire, NSW) computer shop offering dialup access, email and a Net café; earliest capture 12 Dec 1998.

Full "Computing Success Online" ISP site (dialup/email/Net café) last captured Feb 2000; reduced to small placeholder pages thereafter; domain later reused as an IT-services site ("Savings Thru Technology", 2007-08) then a template page (by 2022).
